taxonomy_mappings.confidence_note: Label-based JobSentinel prototype from the publisher API, not a qualification equivalence or completeness claim. The code is the exact ESCO concept URI (ISCO group 2512); the publisher reference documents the catalogue/API, not the individual record.

cv_profiles.label: Europass-informed CV starter
guidance: Choose facts and examples relevant to the vacancy instead of including your entire history.
List recent experience before older experience and write in clear language.
Keep qualifications, experience, and language claims grounded in your own evidence.
This English-only planning aid does not create a Europass file, translate your CV, or determine national requirements.

source_notes.access_note: Public European job-mobility research starting point. Check the individual posting's country and language requirements. This pack does not connect a live source or grant automated access.
